Write short note on the following: (a) Management of a child with some dehydration as per IMNCI guidelines (b) Role of UNICEF in promoting public health (c) Prevention and control of health problems due to lifestyle changes (d) Validity of a screening test (e) Health problems of elderly

(a) Differentiate between: (1) Essential medicine and Counterfeit Medicine (2) Incidence and prevalence (3) Elimination and Eradication (b) Give reasons, why? (1) MR vaccine is not used after 4 hours of reconstitution (2) The trend of diseases should be followed

Multiple choice questions. 1. A person is said to be diabetic when the plasma fasting glucose is more than or equal to (mg/dl): (a) 126 (b) 200 (c) 220 (d) 260 2. The insecticide used for impregnation of mosquito nets is: (a) DDT (b) Deltamethrin (c) Malathion (d) Diazinon 3. In an outbreak of cholera in a village of 2000 population, 20 cases have occurred and 5 died. What is the Case fatality rate? (a) 0.4% (b) 0.25% (c) 4% (d) 25% 4. If a new drug is invented which prevent the mortality from the diseases but does not affect the cure then which of the following will happen: (a) Incidence will increase (b) Incidence will decrease (c) Prevalence will decrease (d) Prevalence will increase
